# Join the swarm Build swarms, not drones. Join the team building the autonomy platform that powers the next generation of defense and robotics. [See all Open Positions](https://auterion.com/company/careers/#open-positions) ###### Mission ## Build swarms, not drones We transform individual drones into AI-enabled nodes of a larger network - creating resilient, coordinated swarms across air, land, and sea. Our open architecture gives democracies scalable, interoperable autonomy that resists jamming and wins at mass scale. ###### Vision ## The leading platform for autonomous systems. We envision millions of unmanned vehicles connected by one common operating system - swarming as a decisive force across defense, industrial, and civil domains, uniting allies and manufacturers into a shared ecosystem for autonomy. ###### Culture ## Grow with us Real-world challenges. Real support. A place to build something meaningful - including who you want to become. ###### Why Auterion ## Join us to build autonomy that truly scales. $ We build at scale. With more than 100,000 Skynode units under contract - orders of magnitude ahead of the market. $ We are solving the hardest problems by directly working with active military personnel and leading commercial companies. $ We execute in days and not weeks. Decisions are made quickly. Ownership is clear. The focus is on execution. $ Join us to build autonomy that truly scales. Come and build something incredible. Including yourself. $ We value performance and merit, not just degrees. ###### How we work ## Our values #### Be bold and audacious Take on ambitious goals, push the boundaries and accept the risk to fail. Prioritize speed. #### Finish the race Take the challenge on from start to finish, do not move on to the next task before delivering to the user. #### Own the outcome Take initiative, do not use others or external factors and unexpected challenges as excuses. #### Team over players We care about the team more than the individual. Put the team first before your own wins. #### Champions keep moving forward What we do is hard, novel and risky - setbacks are expected. Keep moving forward. ###### Open positions ## Build systems that deploy to the field We are an international company with transatlantic travel opportunities. If you want to ship code that deploys to the field within weeks, explore our open roles. Jobs at Auterion Create a Job Alert Level-up your career by having opportunities at Auterion sent directly to your inbox.
